correctness.rationale: For f=(1−z)(1−w), any residual R=1−fp from total-degree ≤n p has total degree ≤L=n+2 and restrictions R(1,w)=R(z,1)=1. Conversely both polynomial identities imply divisibility of 1−R by relatively prime (1−z),(1−w), with quotient total degree≤n. Monomial coefficient row/column sums therefore give a unit R0→C0 flow on bipartite staircase graph edges i+j≤L; squared Hardy coefficient norm equals flow energy and Thomson minimum resistance exactly. Cauchy–Schwarz on two axes with r00=a gives E_n≥min_a(|a|²+2|1−a|²/L)=2/(L+2), all integers n≥0. Choose B=floor √L,M=L−B,K=ceil(M/B), r_i0=r_0i=1/M for i=1..M; for each consecutive block Q of size≤B, set r_{i,M+1−k}=−1/(M|Q|) for i,k∈Q. Interior i+j≤L because i−k≤B−1, all row/column cancellation constraints hold; its energy is exactly 2/M+K/M². Since M=L−O(√L), K=O(√L), squeeze gives E_n=2/n+O(n^{-3/2}) and nE_n→2. Rectangular degree n space is tensor product of one-variable projections with one-dimensional squared defect 1/(n+2), giving Erect=1−(1−1/(n+2))²; inclusion shows E_n≥Erect and matching asymptotic yields O(n^{-3/2}) gap. Actual exact Fraction diagnostic checker source inspected; independently computed n=0 one-variable-parameter optimum E0=3/4 and validated full analytic construction. Finite tests n=0..7 do not constitute infinite proof.

Sargent–Sola arXiv:2002.08790 treats diagonal zero polynomial 1−zw or linear 2−z−w, not the normal-crossing product with coupled total-degree. Specific implication comparisons and residual risk are recorded, rather than declaring failed searches proof of novelty.

value.rationale: A concrete normal-crossing multiplier in H²(D²) is a natural test of multidimensional cyclicity/optimal polynomial approximants. Total-degree restriction destroys rectangular tensor factorization; the exact network-flow reformulation and constructive matching constant 2 at leading squared-error order quantify how cheaply that coupling can be satisfied. This is a motivated, reusable structural bridge from Hardy approximation to electrical networks and an exact asymptotic benchmark, not a purely computational tiny-n value.
